items.prompt: Prove the invariant and cover parser/empty behavior.
items.modelAnswer: Push stores min of new value and old prefix; pop restores previous prefix unchanged. Duplicates each cache. Convert PUSH text to int, emit strings, no PUSH line. Empty reads/pops produce EMPTY without mutation.
